header.reason: Martin, the CFO, compared only rate lines after the bank sharpened its rate, and saw 'the same thing.' Sam blames price, but nothing from us showed what failed orders cost Fernbrook.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with failed big-basket orders at checkout, not average uplift.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Lucy came in because about one in twelve online orders failed at payment, and big baskets failed most.
findings.quote: about one in twelve online orders was failing at the payment step

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell the CFO what failed orders cost next to the rate gap.
findings.why: Sam never met Martin, the CFO, and the only thing from us on his page was our quote.
findings.quote: Martin said no. Lucy told me. I never met him.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer a cheaper bank rate with the orders still failing at it.
findings.why: Lucy told Sam that after the bank sharpened its rate, her questions moved from declines to the rate.
findings.quote: After the bank came back, every email was the rate.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Keep explaining why big orders get declined. Drop the average uplift as lead.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Lucy nodded through Farah's big-order decline explanation, but the average uplift slide never became a Fernbrook figure.
findings.quote: Lucy was nodding the whole way.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a one-page business case showing what failed orders are worth.
findings.why: Lucy asked for something to hand Martin and got the deck, with only customer stories and average uplift.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'orders dying at the last step' instead of 'acceptance rates'.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Lucy described lost greenhouse sales and failed orders, never acceptance rates.
